purpose: Compare ability to fit fixed train measurements with direct shared voxel fields and fresh U-Net; separate optimizer parameterization from conditional network limitations

voxel_sigmoid.parameterization: one case-specific shared sigmoid(logit voxel grid), used for both A/B; mean fresh network output start

voxel_scaled.parameterization: one case-specific shared c0*u voxel grid, projected after each step into [0,1] concentration; same shared initial concentration

unet.parameterization: unchanged fresh registered U-Net with measurement scale initialization, A/B predictions separately

optimizer: AdamW; clip1; cosine T_max300 advanced per16updates, matching pilot update timescale
additional_E: four lowest station IDs disjoint from A/B/H; measured train projections; evaluation only and never input/loss/selection; not external Val or GT
initialization: network from same seed and c0/alpha only, no trained checkpoint; direct shared fields from fresh A/B output mean

interpretation.nontrivial_measurement_fit: final A/B/H each relative L1 <=0.9 and initial total loss decreases
interpretation.independent_ray_check: final E relative L1 <=0.99; report separately; no best-step selection
interpretation.not_a_GO_gate: This experiment cannot authorize formal training or prove 3D reconstruction accuracy

limitations: 2 fixed cases, one seed, fixed sampling
direct shared field is case-specific and cannot assess conditional generalization
scaled-field has different step size and metric; useful for existence/optimization probe, not matched optimizer ranking
H participates original training loss; only E is unseen rays
200 steps does not establish global optimum or universal network failure
